Commentary.Commentary: Amidst the onslaught by the UAE batsmen, the shining start for Hong Kong was Aizaz Khan who took 5 wickets in his 5 overs giving away a mere 28 runs. Had he not been there, UAE might have even crossed 200. Nadeem Ahmed also supported him well taking 3 wickets. Can Hong Kong chase down 177? Or do UAE have enough on the board? The run chase begins in a short while.

The Hong Kong bowlers were just not able to find their lines and lengths due to the UAE onslaught. Ashfaq Ahmed was the biggest thorn, as he continued strong after resumption and finished at 79 in quick time. Since then, UAE have clobbered 111 runs, losing 6 wickets in just 8.4 overs.

A breezy end to the innings means UAE have posted a competitive 176 off their allotted 24 overs. After being 65 for 3 when rain halted play, it was Hong Kong who had the upper hand. However, after play resumed, the batting team launched into fifth gear from the word go.

SIX! Another fine shot to end the innings. UAE end on 176/9. Full on off, Shakoor gets underneath it and sends the ball sailing down the ground. 15 runs from the final over but overall, since the rain break, it has been nothing short of a carnage.
WIDE. Way too far outside off, Shakoor swings but misses. So we still have one ball left in this innings.
Ahmed Raza is the last man in.

OUT! Not a surprise. It has been the case ever since the break. A big hit, then a wicket. Full and outside off, Hayat backs away and looks to go over long on. But there is not enough elevation and Anshuman Rath takes it calmly.
SIX! VIOLENCE! Full and outside off, Amir sends this flying over long on! Miles over!
A low full toss outside off, driven towards long off for a run.
Tossed up now, Shakoor attempts a slow sweep but misses. The keeper whips off the bails but no appeal made for the stumping.
Full and outside off, Hayat gets down and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Abdul Shakoor is the new batsman in.

OUT! Two in Two. Mufti tries to be too smart and pays the price. Khan bowls an off cutter, a bit shorter of good length and around the off stump line. Mufti leans back and tries to run it off the bat face fine of the keeper. However, the connection is not good and the ball kisses the bat and goes straight in the keepper's gloves. An excellent finish to the over by the bowler.
Amir Hayat is the new batsman in.

OUT! Watta stunning catch! This is world class from Hong Kong. Naveed again lofts it, this time towards the cover region. The man at sweeper cover runs in hard, dives and takes a mind-blowing, tumbling catch. Kinchit Shah is the fielder.

SIX! That's magnificent by Naveed. Khan keeps it full around off, Naveed gets under the ball and lofts it straight over the bowler's head. The timing on that one is supreme and the ball sails over the sight screen for another maximum. UAE cruising along.
The batsman paddles the ball down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Mohammad Naveed comes in next.
OUT! Taken at the long on boundary. Usman goes for the big one again, hits it well but the lack of power on the shot means that the fielder at long on settles under it and takes an easy catch.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. They pick up a single
1 run. The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Wonderful shot. Mufti gives himself some room, Khan fires this very full and a bit wide of off. Mufti throws his bat at it, squeezes it through the point region. The timing is good and the placement even better to take the ball across the fence for a boundary.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
The batsman got into position early and reverse swept that one. They pick up a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid-off. They pick up a single.

SIX! Majestic!  The runs are flowing thick and fast now. UAE are managing to score quick runs even if they are losing wickets. Good intent. Usman sees the shorter length and pulls it hard and long over the deep square leg boundary for a huge six. UAE would hope Usman to continue with these big hits.
Usman has driven it straight down the ground for a single.
The batsman plays the square cut. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Smashed! He bowls it just short of a length on the middle and leg line. The batsman swivels and pulls it hard in the gap at deep suare leg. UAE would hope for more of these.
Keeps it very full, wide of off. The batsman premeditates and plays a sweep shot towards deep square leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on the stumps is pushed back to the bowler.
SIX! Mufti picked it early and slog swept it through the leg side. This one's gone all the way over the ropes for a six. What a way to start your innings! Good end to the over for UAE.
Adnan Mufti is the next batsman in.

OUT! Second one of the over. Big blow for UAE. Ahmed tries to whack this across the line, misses the ball and is hit flush on his pads. Looks pretty adjacent. The bowler and keeper appeal and the umpire obliges by raising his finger. Hong Kong doing really well to restrict UAE by picking up important wickets.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Muhammad Usman is the new man in.

OUT! Anwar looking to go for another maximum, perishes. He gets under this full ball on the stumps, heaves it to the cow corner boundary. The fielder there settles under the ball and takes a straightforward catch. UAE lose their fourth wicket.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
SIX! Majestic slog sweep. Ahmed gets down on his knee and gives this a full swing over mid-wicket. Wayyyy goes the ball over. 20 from it. 21 from the previous one from Ehsan.

FOUR! That is a bowler killer! Full and outside off, Ashfaq blasts this straight back over the bowler. Ehsan barely has any time to duck and the ball just eludes his hand. Down the ground to the boundary.
The batsman tries to sweep but gets a top edge towards the on side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

A bit fuller on off, Anwar launches this towards long off but the power in the shot is not enough to take it across the ropes. The fielder at long off runs in to take the catch, gets a hand to it but cannot hold on. The batsmen take a brace.
Driven through mid-on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
SIX! Giagantic! Ahmed sees the ball pitched short and whacks the pull over the deep square leg fence for a huge maximum. Some important quick runs these for UAE.
The batsman drives this through the covers. Good finish to the over by Ahmed. He has come back well here.
The batsman has been hit on the pads as he tried to sweep that one.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Keeps it short again, Ahmed pulls but does not find the gap on this occasion. One run results.
FOUR! Short again and hammered again. Ahmed gets on the back foot and pulls this one in the air towards the mid-wicket region. The timing and placement takes the ball across the ropes.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
Nadeem Ahmed comes on to bowl now.
FOUR! What a shot. Very full on middle, Ashfaq gets down and sweeps this through mid-wicket for a boundary! 21 from the over! Poor Ehsan Khan - his figures get a spike - 5-1-43-0 now.
The batsman plays the pull shot. They pick up a single.
SIX! TONK! He is going after everything now. Tossed up on middle, Anwar comes forward a touch and heaves this way over long on!

Not Out! Anwar survives a close call. Khan tossed this one up just outside off, Anwar looks to hit it over the mid off region, gets beaten by the turn away from him and the keeper whips the bails off and appeals. The umpire referred it upstairs and the replays show that Anwar just managed to get back in time.
Stumping appeal! Shaiman Anwar the batsman in question. Looks tight. Referred upstairs.

FOUR! The bowler overcompenstates and bowls this a bit shorter in length. Anwar takes full toll of the short and wide delivery. He rocks back and across and cuts it beautifully through the point region beating the fielder at point. The ball races to the boundary.
SIX! The batsman has lofted that over mid off. This one's gone all the way over the ropes for a six. Six signalled by the umpire.
Ehsan Khan comes into the attack.
FOUR! A short delivery which has been pulled away. The ball has crossed the ropes. Four runs has been signalled by The Umpire.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. No run there.
SIX! The batsman has played the slog sweep. That was six from the time it left the bat of the batsman. The umpire raises his arms in the air to signal a six.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

The players are out in the middle. The game has been reduced to 24 overs-a-side. Ouch. That will hurt UAE's prospects very badly. They do not even have 10 overs to build a competitive total. How much can they get? Is 150 possible? Let us see. Meanwhile, Shaiman Anwar has walked out to join Ashfaq Ahmed in the middle.

1520 local, 0720 GMT update - Yippee!! Some fantastic news, especially for Hong Kong, that we are scheduled to restart play at 1530 local time (0730 GMT). In all likelihood, this will be a shortened game - but a completed one for sure! Stay tuned for more updates as we shall let you know about the reduction in overs shortly.
1445 local, 0645 GMT update - After an inspection at 1430 local time, the umpires have decided to have another inspection at 3pm local time.

1400 local, 0600 GMT update - Hurray! The rain has stopped and the covers are off! That was quick, wasn't it? Now, comes the main part - INSPECTION. That is scheduled in 10 minutes' time. Fingers crossed...
1330 local, 0530 GMT update - It is still raining at the Kinrara Oval and we are eagerly waiting for it to stop. Stay tuned as we shall keep updating the situation regularly.

1130 local, 0330 GMT update - Nothing much to report from the ground. If any, the rain has gotten even heavier and steadier. The wind has subsided too. Just a reminder - if this match is washed out, UAE WILL PROGRESS BECAUSE OF TOPPING THE GROUP. Surprisingly, no reserve day even for the final.

A good start by the UAE openers is dented heavily due to the loss of three quick wickets. Hong Kong bowlers kept on persisting with their tight lines and lengths and were eventually rewarded for it. One good thing for UAE is that their opener and man in form, Ashfaq Ahmed, is still out in the middle, playing on 43. They will dearly hope that he plays a long innings and guides the team to a fighting total, if not a winning one. Hong Kong, on the other hand, will look to continue picking up regular wickets and try to wrap up the innings as soon as possible.

Shaiman Anwar should have been the new batsman in but he has been replaced by the covers instead. The drizzle has gotten heavier and we are in for a bit of a delay. However, given that the breeze is pretty strong, hopefully, the clouds will be blown away.

OUT! Another one is castled! Third wicket down for UAE and all three have been bowled. Aizaz continues with his tight line and length just around off. Shahzad tries to drive it on the up through the covers but does not move his feet much. The ball lands, seams in ever so slightly to take the inside edge of Shahzad's bat and crashes into the stumps. All of a sudden, UAE have lost some good ground. 54/0 to 65/3.
Aizaz lands this one an a fuller length on the middle stump line. Rameez leans across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
It's getting really dark out there. Ominous signs. Seems like rain is around the corner. Hopefully it passes us. In fact, as I type, it has started to drizzle.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR LEG BYES. Another one down the leg side, Ashfaq misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The ball races to the boundary. The Umpire signals four runs.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Rameez Shahzad is the new man in.

OUT! Timber again! Another beauty, this time from Aizaz. He lands it on a length on middle and off. Mustafa looks to defend but the ball moves away, goes past his defence and hits the top of the off pole. Big blow for UAE as their man in form departs. Two quick wickets for Hong Kong.
Very full delivery on the stumps, drives crisply to mid off.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Aizaz starts the new over with a back of a length delivery on middle. The ball pitches and moves in to cramp the batsman.  Ahmed does well to get some bat on it and run a quick single towards mid on.
Driven towards the mid off region.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Beaten again. Length ball outside off. Mustafa tries to block but gets beaten.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
Rohan Mustafa is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled! What a beauty! It had to be a special delivery to break this solid stand. Tanwir lands this on a good length on the off stump line. The ball pitches and nips away slightly. Suri, looking to block it, is beaten by the away movement and the ball hits the off pole. Suri looks surprised but is gone. That's the first wicket for Hong Kong.
The batsman gets a bottom edge of the bat on that one.
Lands this one full on off. Suri creams the drive through covers to get another single.
Keeps it a bit fuller of good length outside off, Suri leans forward and drives it to deep covers for a single.
The ball has been square driven by the batsman.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball, but fails.
FOUR LEG BYES! Down the leg side, Suri looks to tuck it fine but the ball hits his thigh pads and rolls away to the fine leg fence.
Ahmed failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A length ball outside off is driven crisply but straight to covers.
Keeps it on a length around off, defended off the front foot.
Starts the new over with an off cutter on a length just outside off. Ahmed looking to defend gets an inside edge towards square leg. They pick up a single.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Four fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! The batsman plays the Square-Cut. The ball has crossed the ropes. The Umpire signals a boundary.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh-pad.
Aizaz Khan is the first bowling change.
FOUR! Super shot this. Afzal lands this one on a length, angling in. Suri whips it across the line over the mid-wicket region. The ball races to the boundary.
Suri gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

The batsman is a bit lucky there. Afzal lands this fuller on the off stump line. Ahmed looks to swing it through the line, but there is a bit of extra bounce. The ball hits a bit high on his bat and lobs over the bowler. The fielders at mid off and mid on run behind to catch it but the ball evades both of them. The batsmen run a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.

SIX! Delightful! Ashfaq is enjoying himself out there. This is a gentle half volley on the pads but the measures from the batsman are nowhere near gentle. Whipped with full power over mid-wicket. Goes a long, long way. 16 from the over! Nawaz' figures take a pounding - 4-1-22-0 so far. Just take this over away from that and calculate the bowling figures...
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

SIX! Luck favours the brave. Ahmed takes on the short delivery, tries to pull it but gets a top edge on it. The ball flies towards fine leg and seems to have bounced just in front of the ropes. Initially, a boundary is signalled, but then replays confirm that it has crossed over. The correct signal is made.
The batsman gets a leading edge on that one.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Nawaz lands this one a bit shorter of good length outside off, Ahmed uses the pace of the delivery, opens the face of the bat slightly and guides this one past the diving point fielder. The fielder at third man runs across to try and cut it off but cannot reach it and the ball crosses the ropes at the point boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

An off cutter on a length outside off, the batsman tries to go for an ambitious drive on the up through the off side. The ball hits the deck and nips back in. Suri is beaten by the inward movement as the keeper pouches it.
The batsman has edged that one.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Full length ball is driven superbly through the covers.
On a length outside off, defended from the crease.
Thick inside edge by the batsman, ball goes down to fine leg. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Suri has punched that ball through the off side.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. One run added to the total.
Wide! Banged in Short. Unusual bounce. Too high to worry the batsman! The Umpire signals a wide.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Yes. It is a MAIDEN. A length ball outside off, Suri walks forward and blocks it towards the bowler. This is the second maiden of the innings.
Half volley outside off, driven straight to cover. A maiden on the cards?
Full again, driven straight to mid on.
Fuller and outside off, driven through the covers where a good diving stop by Ehsan Khan saves runs. Probably a boundary.
Tighter line, much straighter, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Suri comes forward and blocks it towards cover.

Good ball by Nawaz. He keeps it on a length just outside off, Suri looking to push it into the off side gets a thick outside edge and the ball runs down to third man region. The batsmen take a single.
Lands this one fuller and wide of the off pole, the batsman shoulders arms.
Nawaz pulls his length back a bit, punched through covers for a brace.
Nawaz keeps it on a length on off, Suri comes forward and defends.
Outside off again and Chirag has nothing to do with it.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Suri.
SIX! WHACK! Afzal fires this one on Ahmed's legs, who leans across and nonchalantly whips this one over the mid-wicket region for a gigantic maximum. That shot will give him immense confidence.

FOUR! Wonderful shot! Ahmed sees the width on this fuller delivery outside off, he reaches out, throws his hands at the ball and lofts this over the cover-point region. The ball, after bouncing a couple of times, crosses the boundary at point. Good aggressive intent by Ahmed.
Good length ball angled into the pads, Ahmed tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Lands this a bit shorter of a length around off, Ahmed gets back and punches this to covers.
Good length ball on off, is driven straight to mid off.
Afzal starts off the new over with a length ball around off and angling into Ahmed, Ashfaq tries to whip it off his pads but misses and gets rapped on the thigh pad.
Nawaz keeps this just outside off, Suri shoulders arms.
Pulls his length back and keeps it on the off stump line, Suri gets behind the line and blocks it.

Dropped! That was a sitter. Hong Kong cannot afford to drop such easy chances. Nawaz keeps it on a length but angling into Suri. The batsman leans across and flicks it aerially. Nadeem Ahmed at short mid-wicket moves low to his right and should have taken it but he drops an easy catch. How costly will this prove to be?
Suri leaves this length ball outside off.
Nawaz fires this on the middle and leg line, Suri clips it straight to square leg.
A bit short of a length around off, Suri defends it off the back foot
Ehsan Nawaz to bowl with the second new ball.

FOUR! Fine Shot! Afzal errs on the final ball of the over and pays the price for it. Ahmed sees the length is short, rocks back, swivels and pulls it handsomely through the deep square leg region for the first boundary of UAE's innings.
Good length ball around off, Ahmed keeps it out off the front foot.
Afzal keeps this a bit back of a length outside off, Ahmed rocks back and taps this one to the fielder at point.
Accurate bowling from Afzal, lands it on a good length in the off stump corridor, Ahmed defends off the front foot.
Keeps it a bit fuller outside off, Ashfaq watchfully leaves it alone.
Starts off with a short of a length ball on off, Ashfaq punches this to covers off the back foot.

Okay! Time for the final to begin. The concerned men are out in the middle. Tanwir Afzal to start off proceedings with the first new ball. Ashfaq Ahmed and Chirag Suri will open up for Hong Kong. Ashfaq will take strike. Here we go!!!

Rohan Mustafa says that he was looking to bat first anyways. Is not too worried about the dampness in the surface and feels that different people have different opinions. Wants his side to go out today and play well.

Anshuman Rath says that the reason for bowling first is because of the dampness in the pitch and also the overcast conditions above. Reckons that UAE are a very good team and a win earlier against them definitely has boosted his team. Hopes to replicate that performance today as well.
Time for the toss. Rohan Mustafa flips the coin, Anshuman Rath calls Tails and it is a Tail. HONG KONG WILL CHASE.

Hong Kong will have a slightly upper hand though as they annihilated UAE by 182 runs during their preliminary round clash. On the other hand, UAE have outperformed all other teams in the tournament. They will be keen on turning the tables today. Hopefully we get a humdinger of a clash between the two best teams of the tournament and we hope the deserving team lifts the trophy.

Hello all and a warm welcome to our coverage of the final match of the Asia Cup Qualifiers 2018 at the Kinrara Academy Oval in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Both the finalists, UAE and Hong Kong will be eager to finish on a high by winning the tournament and more importantly qualify for the Asia Cup, which starts on 15th Sept in UAE.
